deliverables: Deliver an open, standardized interface across Cardano's leading on-chain protocols over 12 months
Onboard 12 additional protocols, 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage
Develop an MCP server for agents to discover and call published protocols
Develop a protocol skills framework and agent-first documentation
Provide documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe
request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, including developer and agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is described as a framework where each protocol is specified once with a verified interface definition that generates documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 already put Tx3's developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal commits to 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, with developer and agent coverage.
The proposal states that protocols such as Strike Finance, Indigo Protocol, VyFinance, Bodega Market, and Fluid Tokens are already accessible through Tx3.
The proposer claims there is no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, causing integrators to relearn each protocol and making cross-protocol composability impractical.
The proposer claims AI agents require discoverable, auditable, deterministic shared interfaces for Cardano protocols because hallucinated on-chain transactions can irreversibly move real assets.
The proposal states it passed the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved framework.
The proposal states the requested amount did not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.

The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus Intersect 2025 funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

summary: The proposal seeks 1,684,050 ADA for TxPipe's Tx3 work over 12 months, centered on standardized Cardano protocol interfaces, additional protocol onboarding, AI-agent support, MCP infrastructure, and Intersect-managed smart-contract disbursement and oversight.
